g.text: The portal carries two workloads with opposite
(FR-001 - 200 services every 30 s, each with a
5 s timeout) and bursty CPU-bound graph
In one deployable they share a thread pool, so a
bad probe cycle is felt as graph latency.
Splitting them also isolates the two hang-prone
outbound calls - the OpenAPI fetch (FR-004) and
alert dispatch (FR-005) - so the portal survives
the very outages it exists to report.
